\vspace{0.25cm}

\noindent\textbf{\large Option 1 — Guest WiFi (GWguest)}

\noindent For all conference attendees without a GW or eduroam account.

\vspace{0.2cm}

\begin{mdframed}[backgroundcolor=lightgray, linecolor=gwblue, linewidth=1.5pt, innerleftmargin=12pt, innerrightmargin=12pt, innertopmargin=7pt, innerbottommargin=7pt]
\begin{enumerate}
  \setlength{\itemsep}{3pt}
  \item Open your device's \textbf{WiFi settings} and select \textbf{GWguest}.
  \item If prompted with a certificate warning for \texttt{cppm.it.gwu.edu}, tap \textbf{Accept} or \textbf{Trust} (this is a GWU-issued certificate and is safe).
  \item Open a \textbf{web browser} — you will be automatically redirected to the self-registration page. If not, navigate to \texttt{my.gwu.edu}.
  \item Enter your name and email address to self-register. Access is valid for \textbf{72 hours}.
\end{enumerate}
\end{mdframed}

\vspace{0.35cm}

\noindent\textbf{\large Option 2 — eduroam (Academic Institutions)}

\noindent If your home institution participates in eduroam, you can connect directly.

\vspace{0.2cm}

\begin{mdframed}[backgroundcolor=lightgray, linecolor=gwgold, linewidth=1.5pt, innerleftmargin=12pt, innerrightmargin=12pt, innertopmargin=7pt, innerbottommargin=7pt]
\begin{enumerate}
  \setlength{\itemsep}{3pt}
  \item Open your device's \textbf{WiFi settings} and select \textbf{eduroam}.
  \item Sign in using your \textbf{home institution credentials} (e.g., \texttt{username@youruniversity.edu}).
  \item No additional registration is required.
\end{enumerate}
\end{mdframed}
